title: payload: broker.get_account
description: DEPRECATED: superseded by broker.get_accounts (see payloads/broker.get_accounts.json) — kept for wire compatibility with AFB builds that have not negotiated multi_account (see daemon.capabilities.json#/properties/features/properties/multi_account, session.hello_ack.json#/properties/features/properties/multi_account). AFB always sends an empty payload; no fields are read by BF (belphegor/plan_engine/engine.py::_get_account).
